remarks: Just a short stroll from the historic heart of San Juan Capistrano, this distinctive residence combines architectural character, inviting outdoor spaces, and an exceptional location in one of OC’s most charming and walkable communities, with some of the city's most beloved destinations right at your doorstep. Equally special is the home itself, where Spanish architecture, cathedral ceilings, and custom woodwork create warmth and personality. The main living level brings together the kitchen, dining, and family rooms beneath a dramatic vaulted tongue-and-groove ceiling. The kitchen features granite countertops, generous island with bar seating, farmhouse sink, and KitchenAid appliances
